dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Do you need something, dear customer? Say the word, and I shall procure it through my connections — anything you wish.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Of course, of course — worry not, everything you might need can be found here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Do you know a lot of people?

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Indeed, and not merely people from Fontaine, no — I have many friends from abroad.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: I've been a traveling merchant since I was young, but as my journey wore on, I felt that spending my days peacefully at home suited me better.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Well now, if I did tell you, I'd have another competitor in this world, now wouldn't I?

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Anyway, I know a friend or two in almost any corner.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: But don't worry, every nook is safe, and none of them are the Fortress of Meropide. A peaceful life is what I desire, not one afoul of the law.

dialogues.speaker: Boucicaut
dialogues.text: Alright, but I do hope that this will become your one-stop-shop someday.
